rows.grounds: object of knowing; the true principle
demonstrative pointing to the described reality
compound denoting those constituted by the bondage of existence

items.question: What effect does knowing this reality have on those constituted by worldly bondage?
premises: This reality is an object that can be known.
Some beings are constituted by the bondage of worldly existence.
Direct knowledge of reality bears on the condition of bondage.
items.inference: Knowing this reality transforms the condition of those constituted by worldly bondage.
uncertainties: The verse is a fragmentary tail, so the main predicate completing the effect is absent.
The referent of bhava+bandhā+tmakaiḥ could be beings or bonds depending on the missing context.
items.plain_english: O goddess, O beloved, having known this reality, [one is affected] in relation to those constituted by the bondage of worldly existence.
